arxiv-2102-03958.title: Compressed Shaping: Concept and FPGA Demonstration
arxiv-2102-03958.creator: Tsuyoshi Yoshida, Koji Igarashi, Magnus Karlsson, Erik Agrell
arxiv-2102-03958.description: Abstract Probabilistic shaping (PS) has been widely studied and applied to optical fiber communications. The encoder of PS expends the number of bit slots and controls the probability distribution of channel input symbols. Not only studies focused on PS but also most works on optical fiber communications have assumed source uniformity (i.e. equal probability of marks and spaces) so far.

arxiv-2103-07858.title: Thickness dependence of work function, ionization energy, and electron affinity of Mo and W dichalcogenides from DFT and GW calculations
arxiv-2103-07858.creator: Han-gyu Kim, Hyoung Joon Choi
arxiv-2103-07858.description: Abstract Transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are promising for two-dimensional (2D) semiconducting devices and novel phenomena. For 2D applications, their work function, ionization energy, and electron affinity are required as a function of thickness, but research on this is yet to cover the full family of compounds.

arxiv-2108-02968.title: Deductive Verification via the Debug Adapter Protocol
arxiv-2108-02968.creator: Gidon Ernst Johannes Blau, Toby Murray
arxiv-2108-02968.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gidon Ernst Johannes Blau, Toby Murray. We propose a conceptual integration of deductive program verification into existing user interfaces for software debugging. This integration is well-represented in the “Debug Adapter Protocol”, a widely-used and generic technology to integrate debugging of programs into development environments. Commands like step-forward and step-in are backed by steps of a symbolic structural operational semantics, and the different paths through a program are readily represented by multiple running threads of the debug target inside the user interface.

arxiv-2204-09683.title: 3D Hydrodynamical Simulations of Helium-Ignited Double-degenerate White Dwarf Mergers FLASH 4.0.1 ( Fryxell et al. 2000b ; Dubey et al. 2012 ) , FLASH SN Ia module Townsley et al. 2016 ( http://pages.astronomy.ua.edu/townsley/code ), yt ( Turk et al. 2011 ) , Python programming language ( van Rossum
arxiv-2204-09683.creator: Niranjan C. Roy, Vishal Tiwari, Alexey Bobrick, Daniel Kosakowski, Robert Fisher, Hagai B. Perets, Rahul Kashyap, Pablo Lorén-Aguilar, Enrique García-Berro
arxiv-2204-09683.description: Abstract The origins of type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) are still debated. Some of the leading scenarios involve a double detonation in double white dwarf (WD) systems. In these scenarios, helium shell detonation occurs on top of a carbon-oxygen (CO) WD, which then drives the detonation of the CO-core, producing a SN Ia.

arxiv-2303-01137.title: Algebraic Monograph Transformations
arxiv-2303-01137.creator: Thierry Boy de la Tour
arxiv-2303-01137.description: Abstract Monographs are graph-like structures with directed edges of unlimited length that are freely adjacent to each other. The standard nodes are represented as edges of length zero. They can be drawn in a way consistent with standard graphs and many others, like E-graphs or ∞ \infty -graphs.

arxiv-2404-19420.title: Let’s Focus: Focused Backdoor Attack against Federated Transfer Learning
arxiv-2404-19420.creator: Marco Arazzi, Stefanos Koffas, Antonino Nocera, Stjepan Picek
arxiv-2404-19420.description: Abstract . Federated Transfer Learning (FTL) is the most general variation of Federated Learning. According to this distributed paradigm, a feature learning pre-step is commonly carried out by only one party, typically the server, on publicly shared data. After that, the Federated Learning phase takes place to train a classifier collaboratively using the learned feature extractor.

arxiv-2411-15963.title: Reformulating Regression Test Suite Optimization using Quantum Annealing - an Empirical Study
arxiv-2411-15963.creator: Antonio Trovato, Manuel De Stefano, Fabiano Pecorelli, Dario Di Nucci, Andrea De Lucia
arxiv-2411-15963.description: Abstract Maintaining software quality is crucial in the dynamic landscape of software development. Regression testing ensures that software works as expected after changes are implemented. However, re-executing all test cases for every modification is often impractical and costly, particularly for large systems.

arxiv-2509-07221.title: When (not) to trust Monte Carlo approximations for hierarchical Bayesian inference
arxiv-2509-07221.creator: Jack Heinzel, Salvatore Vitale
arxiv-2509-07221.description: Abstract The coming years of gravitational wave astrophysics promises thousands of new detections, which can unlock fundamental scientific insights if the information in each observation can be properly synthesized into a coherent picture. State-of-the-art approaches often accomplish this with hierarchical Bayesian inference.

arxiv-2510-12092.title: On the generalized Fermat equation x 13 + y 13 = z n x^{13}+y^{13}=z^{n} Thanks: The first two named authors were supported by NWO Vidi grant 639.032.613. We thank the Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in Bonn for its hospitality on several occasions, which enabled the last two named authors to c

arxiv-2510-12092.description: Abstract . Let n ∈ ℤ ≥ 2 n\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 2} . We study the generalized Fermat equation x 13 + y 13 = z n , x , y , z ∈ ℤ , gcd ⁡ ( x , y , z ) = 1 . x^{13}+y^{13}=z^{n},\quad x,y,z\in\mathbb{Z},\quad\gcd(x,y,z)=1.

arxiv-2601-14121.title: NewsRECON: News article REtrieval for image CONtextualization
arxiv-2601-14121.creator: Jonathan Tonglet, Iryna Gurevych, Tinne Tuytelaars, Marie-Francine Moens
arxiv-2601-14121.description: Abstract Identifying when and where a news image was taken is crucial for journalists and forensic experts to produce credible stories and debunk misinformation. While many existing methods rely on reverse image search (RIS) engines, these tools often fail to return results, thereby limiting their practical applicability. In this work, we address the challenging scenario where RIS evidence is unavailable.

arxiv-2602-05850.title: An Equational Axiomatization of Dynamic Threads via Algebraic Effects DOI: 10.1145/3776706 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 10 POPL 64 1 CCS: Theory of computation Denotational semantics CCS: Theory of computation Categorical semantics CCS: Theory of computation Concurrency
arxiv-2602-05850.creator: Ohad Kammar, Jack Liell-Cock, Sam Lindley, Cristina Matache, Sam Staton
arxiv-2602-05850.description: Abstract . We use the theory of algebraic effects to give a complete equational axiomatization for dynamic threads. Our method is based on parameterized algebraic theories, which give a concrete syntax for strong monads on functor categories, and are a convenient framework for names and binding. Our programs are built from the key primitives ‘fork’ and ‘wait’.

arxiv-2602-23168.title: Sorting Methods for Online Deliberation: Towards a Principled Approach
arxiv-2602-23168.creator: Nicolien Janssens, Frederik Van De Putte
arxiv-2602-23168.description: Abstract Recent years have seen an increase in the use of online deliberation platforms (DPs). One of the main objectives of DPs is to enhance democratic participation, by allowing citizens to post, comment, and vote on policy proposals. But in what order should these proposals be listed?

babylonian-talmud-rodkinson-vol-8.title: The Babylonian Talmud (Rodkinson), Vol. 8: Tracts Taanith, Megilla, and Ebel Rabbathi
babylonian-talmud-rodkinson-vol-8.creator: Michael L. Rodkinson, trans.
babylonian-talmud-rodkinson-vol-8.description: Volume 8 of Michael L. Rodkinson's English translation of the Babylonian Talmud (Tracts Taanith, Megilla, and Ebel Rabbathi). Complete 20-volume set; the first full English Talmud translation.

pmc-10547437.title: The prevalence of anemia in people with chronic kidney disease after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
pmc-10547437.creator: Małgorzata Kępska-Dzilińska, Ewa Karakulska-Prystupiuk, Aleksandra Kaszyńska, Grzegorz W Basak, Jolanta Małyszko
pmc-10547437.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is performed for various hematological diseases. Chronic kidney disease (CKD) occurs relatively often after HSCT. Anemia after HSCT may be due to CKD and/or other reasons. The aim of this study is to assess the prevalence of anemia and its possible relationship to the presence of CKD in patients at least 3 months after HSCT.

pmc-10721347.title: First Clinical Case of Ilizarov Femur Lengthening over a Bioactive and Degradable Intramedullary Implant
pmc-10721347.creator: Arnold Popkov, Sergei Tverdokhlebov, Sergei Muradisinov, Dmitry Popkov
pmc-10721347.description: Introduction The Ilizarov distraction osteogenesis is a recognized method of limb lengthening in orthopaedic practice. Its most challenging problems are long duration of external fixation and related pin-tract infection and joint contractures. The solution might be the use of a bioactive degradable intramedullary implant stimulating bone healing. Case Presentation.

pmc-11367502.title: Real-world outcomes of micropulse transscleral laser therapy in glaucoma patients: Efficacy of initial and repeated treatment, transient intraocular pressure spikes
pmc-11367502.creator: Thomas Dervos, Laura L. Fortuna, Konstantin Gugleta, Hendrik P.N. Scholl, Zisis Gatzioufas, Pascal W. Hasler, Valentin Arabin, Tim J. Enz
pmc-11367502.description: PurposeTo investigate the clinical outcomes of micropulse transscleral laser therapy (MP-TLT) in a cohort of glaucoma patients, including safety profile, post-operative transient intraocular pressure (IOP) spikes, long-term efficacy and prognostic factors in terms of IOP-lowering.MethodsThis was a retrospective observational cohort study.

pmc-12068422.title: Counterion Exchange Enhances the Brightness and Photostability of a Fluorous Cyanine Dye
pmc-12068422.creator: Helen H. Lin, Irene Lim, Ellen M. Sletten
pmc-12068422.description: Fluorofluorophores are a unique class of fluorophores that can be solubilized in perfluorocarbons (PFCs) and used to study biological systems. However, because of the low dielectric constant and high oxygen solubility in the fluorous phase, the brightness and photostability of the fluorofluorophores are significantly diminished.

pmc-12657295.title: A Systematic Literature Review of Coordinated Care in Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Conditions
pmc-12657295.creator: O. Kenrik Duru, Radica Alicic, Muthiah Vaduganathan, Wendy L. St. Peter, Glenda V. Roberts, Janani Rangaswami, Susanne B. Nicholas, Joshua J. Neumiller, Roy O. Mathew, Patrick Gee, Katherine R. Tuttle
pmc-12657295.description: ObjectiveTo assess coordinated cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) care programs, including program types, components, and outcomes.Patients and MethodsWe searched Embase and Medline for studies from January 1, 2015 through March 9, 2023, and congress abstracts from January 1, 2021 through March 9, 2023.

pmc-13235944.title: Shaken batch cultures of Pseudomonas aeruginosa contain biofilm-like heterogeneity
pmc-13235944.creator: B. G Fritz, M.H Christensen, L Heiland, T Tolker-Nielsen, T.H Jakobsen, PØ Jensen, T Bjarnsholt
pmc-13235944.description: Two potential sources of differentially tolerant subpopulations of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in batch cultures are aggregation and growth rates. Here, we dissected these effects by treating batch cultures with tobramycin, colistin and a combination after various time intervals. Tobramycin was significantly more effective than colistin at early time points, while both showed similar efficacy at 24 and 48 h.

uslaw-usc-t15-s690b.title: 15 U.S.C. § 690b — Establishment
uslaw-usc-t15-s690b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s690b.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 14B (Small Business Investment Program); Subchapter III (Investment Division Programs); Part C (Renewable Fuel Capital Investment Pilot Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Administrator shall establish a Renewable Fuel Capital Investment Program, under which the Administrator may— (1) enter into participation agreements for the purposes described in section 690a of this title.
